headline: Executive order directs the federal government to stop buying paper straws and to end requirements that people use them.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells federal agencies to stop purchasing paper straws. It also aims to end rules or policies that require the use of paper straws instead of other kinds, such as plastic. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They would stop buying paper straws as part of their purchasing.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that sell straws to the federal government
who_it_affects.how: Demand from federal buyers could shift away from paper straws toward other types.

who_it_affects.group: Federal employees and visitors to federal buildings
who_it_affects.how: The straws offered in federal facilities could change from paper to other materials.

when_it_takes_effect: Executive orders generally take effect when signed, which was February 10, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the title.
